verdict.rationale: Stripe Connect is a payments platform/API, not an AI agent or assistant that hosts tools and consumes MCP servers as a client. The evidence shows Stripe offers an official MCP *server* (docs.stripe.com/mcp) for AI agents to call into Stripe, which is the reverse relationship — not Stripe Connect acting as an MCP client plugging in external servers. This axis is a category error for a payments infrastructure product.
